serverInfo.name: anuarafar-mcp
serverInfo.title: Anuarul Arhivei de Folclor — read-only catalog
serverInfo.vendor: Institutul Arhiva de Folclor a Academiei Romane (IAFAR)
serverInfo.description: Read-only access to the AAF journal archive: list issues, fetch issue/article metadata, search articles. Editorial workflow endpoints (auth, submissions, reviewer assignments) are not exposed via MCP.

tools.name: listIssues
tools.description: List all journal issues. Returns id, slug, year, volume, number, title, series, status.

tools.name: getIssue
tools.description: Fetch a single issue by slug, including its article list. Inputs: { slug: string }.

tools.name: getArticle
tools.description: Fetch a single article's metadata by id (title, authors, abstract, keywords, pdf_path, doi). Inputs: { id: string }.

tools.name: searchArticles
tools.description: Search articles by query against title, authors, abstract, keywords. Inputs: { query: string, limit?: number }.
